status: Flat routing study; installed tail routing and assembly qualification remain
notes: The manufacturer catalog specifies a 7 mm standard six-position tail, 0.65 mm fingers, at least 3.5 mm exposed length, 0.30 +/- 0.05 mm finished thickness and a stiffener at least 0.188 mm thick.
The narrower required outline/pad tolerances are assembly requirements to verify with the fabricator; the general trace-width tolerance is not a guarantee for the mating contacts.
Exposed contact sections omit opposite-side copper/coverlay so the 0.225 mm stiffener can produce the required finished thickness.
Straight tails here exercise routed artwork and independent DRC. They are not the final installed routing and must not be ordered as a completed finger package.
